complexityBudget.rule: Complexity checkpoints are revisable release guardrails, not product invariants, capability deletion targets or reasons to reject a demonstrated collaboration-closure need. After P4 admitted the first production module, independent review required source-complete GT-17/18 validation, the f898ebd audit exposed missing responsibility-scoped retirement, later review exposed empty-policy admission and duplicate-key Hook parsing, and candidate audit exposed missing exact behavior-subject binding. The active increment therefore permits at most 86 tracked files and 364000 product-code-and-test bytes while retaining at least five percent byte headroom and three tracked-file slots. The bounded increase pays only for stable closure admission, scoped retirement, shared strict parsing, fail-closed sparse task-subject validation, exact old-to-new evaluator-delta proof, safe bounded Git reads and their negative regressions; it is not advance allowance for a Runtime, host adapter, storage layer, framework or future mechanism. Historical and revised observations remain compacted into existing carriers, immutable Git history preserves superseded facts, and the result remains far below the 1551209-byte baseline. Count code, prompts, context, state, processes, evidence, user cognition, latency, interference, recovery, maintenance and retirement. At each breach or same-purpose repair, compare deletion, native delegation, composition, replacement and bounded addition; retain only outcome-bearing semantics or mechanisms with verified lifecycle and cleanup.

processLossControl.alignmentRule: From the earliest affected boundary, reconcile each correction against the proposition set across authority, four mappings, implementation, evidence, documentation and claims; preserve unrelated truth and history, and stop affected work while a conflict remains.
processLossControl.resourceRule: Observe current demand and capacity, attribute identity, owner, lease and state, admit minimum sufficient concurrency and budget, rebalance or degrade under pressure, release only attributable task-owned exposure through authorized native controls, and independently verify post-state and residue. Shared or unknown ownership is never reclaimed automatically; sufficient native whole-loop governance is a no-op and an Accord-specific mechanism retirement trigger.
processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. Compact only reduces memory on the current carrier, a copied-history fork is a causal branch, and sequential load relief uses a fresh zero-history destination with minimum verified state transfer, destination reconciliation and only then source release. These conversation operations do not change code topology or local/cloud execution placement; bind either separately when required. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A material correction, failure, later rule or revision supersedes affected current-candidate evidence from the earliest dependency boundary. It governs direction immediately but is admitted as the next implementation baseline only after proposition-level contradiction, category, boundary and dependency checks; unresolved conflict pauses affected work. The boundary and every downstream gate are replayed while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses the current shape until premise, interface and representation are reconsidered; deletion, replacement, recomposition, native-host delegation and bounded addition are all considered. There is no universal add-or-subtract default, while L2 requires a deletion or replacement attempt before another same-purpose repair layer. Authority surfaces form a reviewable versioned current set; their merge, split, replacement or retirement requires explicit provenance-preserving schema and verifier migration plus the same earliest-boundary replay.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Feasibility findings, prototype counterevidence, representative or longitudinal failures and later field evidence may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment. Each material update first rechecks the proposition set and affected dependency graph; neither consensus, a ready baseline nor a release freezes learning, and none licenses a contradictory baseline.
processLossControl.boundedAutonomyRule: At each material phase, sense environment composition and Accord exposure; recompute the latest outcome obligations, consensus, relevant relations and constraints, healthy effective and reusable capabilities, genuinely non-delegable human judgment, unclosed obligations and risks. Feasibility precedes implementation. Preserve each material correction through the four mapped surfaces, chosen product form, implementation, evidence, documentation, acceptance and claim; self-evolution remains subordinate to full-loop outcome, authority, rollback and retirement.
